name: Puja Ohlhaver
description: Puja Ohlhaver is a lawyer and technologist renovating democracy to resist authoritarian drift in the age of AI. As a member of the GETTING-Plurality Research Group at Harvard’s Allen Lab, she explores how cryptography and AI can empower communities to scale cooperation without succumbing to surveillance. Her recent work explores how community currencies can rebalance attention and influence to amplify collective voice while hardening frontier models against capture and overreach. Ohlhaver co-authored Decentralized Society: Finding Web3’s Soul with Glen Weyl and Vitalik Buterin, and her commentary has appeared in The New York Times, Washington Post, Politico, WIRED, and Time.
